newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB to unveil restructuring, overseas pullout -- NHK.
newsitem.headline: NCB to unveil restructuring, overseas pullout -- NHK.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank Ltd will announce a restructuring plan on Tuesday that will include a complete withdrawal from overseas operations, NHK television network reported.
An NCB spokesman said the bank had no plans so far to hold a news conference.
Nippon Credit Bank said last week it was working out a restructuring plan to be announced in early April but did not disclose details.
Banking sources said it would include the sale of real estate and shutting down some overseas operations.
Separately on Tuesday the daily Nihon Kogyo Shimbun reported that Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd was the leading candidate to take over NCB's overseas business.
